content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable: Experience in Academic institute / Govt / Autonomous / PSU.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Higher pay will be considered based on experience and expertise of the candidate. Initially for ONE year, renewable depending on requirement and discretion of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Tirupati Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a selection process Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Detailed CV specifying qualifications and experience Scanned copies of experience certificates Marksheets from Class X onwards

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit a detailed CV specifying qualifications and experience via the online application link. Attach scanned copies of experience certificates and marksheets from Class X onwards. Apply on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the selection process. IIT Tirupati reserves the right to discontinue the position with one month's notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Executive (Accounts).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Tirupati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years (as on since the last date of advertisement). Relaxation: The upper age limit may be relaxed for exceptionally good candidates based on the committee's decision..

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 – 40,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master of Commerce (M.Com) with 55% marks OR Bachelor's degree in any discipline with 60% marks and 3 years relevant experience in accounting OR CA (IPCC)/ CMA (inter) qualified.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a selection process. Shortlisted candidates will be notified via email regarding the selection process.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initially for ONE year, renewable depending on requirement and discretion of the Institute.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tirupati.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Detailed CV specifying qualifications and experience; Scanned copies of experience certificates; Marksheets from Class X onwards.
